tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate an IBAN offline: country rules, length, BBAN structure, mod-97 checksum. Returns validity, country, SEPA flag and formatted IBAN. Structural check only: cannot tell whether the account exists.

tools.name: validate_bic
tools.description: Validate a BIC/SWIFT code structure (8 or 11 chars), country, location and branch code.

tools.name: validate_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU/EEA (plus GB, NO, CH and more) VAT number format and checksum offline. Does not check VIES registration status.

tools.name: validate_card
tools.description: Luhn check and network detection (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, Diners, JCB, UnionPay, Maestro, Mir). Returns masked output only; nothing is stored.

tools.name: validate_isbn
tools.description: Validate ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 check digit and convert between the two.

tools.name: validate_batch
tools.description: Validate up to 25 mixed identifiers (iban, bic, vat, card, isbn, gtin) in one call.

tools.name: stablecoin_peg_verdict
tools.description: Live peg-health verdict for USD stablecoins: PEGGED / WATCH / DEPEG_RISK / DEPEGGED, 0-100 risk score, price deviation in bps, 1d/7d/30d supply change and per-chain liquidity, computed from DefiLlama (cached 5 min).
